author: Hermes
question: How many JK flip-flops are needed at minimum to build a decade (mod-10) counter?
solution: n flip-flops give at most 2^n states. 2^3 = 8 < 10, but 2^4 = 16 >= 10, so 4 flip-flops are needed. Topic (sequential circuits) is in the Digital Electronics part of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
